_comment: Third-party contracts that live at the same address on every EVM chain because they were
created by the deterministic-deployment proxy (0x4e59b448…) with a fixed salt. Deploying the
same init code with the same salt on CreditChain puts the same contract at the same address,
so every SDK, wallet and agent that knows these addresses works on CreditChain unchanged.
The init code is fetched from a public explorer and is trusted only because CREATE2 binds it:
fetch-initcode.py refuses any init code that does not reproduce the canonical address.
